opportunities.name: Trip.com attractions search, sort and open top result
opportunities.description: On Trip.com Attractions & Tickets, search a {destination} with a {keyword}, sort results by {sort_order}, and open a chosen attraction to view its details/price.
steps: Open trip.com and click the Attractions & Tickets tab
Click the Destination field, type {destination} and pick the matching suggestion
Click the Keywords field and type {keyword}
On the results page click the {sort_order} sort tab
Click the {attraction} result to open its detail page
Review details/price (e.g. open the Nearby tab)
